# pdf_generator.rb - PDF generation library with audit logging
require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'time'
require 'securerandom'
require 'base64'
require 'openssl'

module PDFAudit
  class SecurityContext
    attr_reader :session_id, :document_id, :entropy_pool

    def initialize(user_id:, document_title:)
      @user_id = user_id
      @document_title = document_title
      @created_at = Time.now.utc
      @entropy_pool = initialize_entropy_pool
      @session_id = generate_session_id
      @document_id = generate_document_id
    end

    def generate_audit_token
      timestamp = Time.now.utc.to_i
      payload = "#{@session_id}:#{@document_id}:#{timestamp}"
      hmac = compute_hmac(payload)
      Base64.strict_encode64("#{payload}:#{hmac}")
    end

    def generate_watermark_seed
      # Used to create unique invisible watermarks for document tracking
      derive_deterministic_value("watermark", @document_id)
    end

    def generate_encryption_iv
      # IV for PDF stream encryption
      derive_deterministic_value("encryption_iv", @session_id)
    end

    def encryption_key
      # Derive a symmetric key for stream encryption from the entropy pool.
      derive_deterministic_value("encryption_key", @entropy_pool)
    end

    private

    def initialize_entropy_pool
      # Collect system entropy for cryptographic operations
      sources = [
        SecureRandom.hex(32),
        Time.now.utc.to_f.to_s,
        Process.pid.to_s
      ]
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(sources.join(':'))
    end

    def generate_session_id
      # Session ID for audit trail correlation
      raw = derive_deterministic_value("session", @entropy_pool)
      "SES-#{raw[0..15]}"
    end

    def generate_document_id
      raw = derive_deterministic_value("document", @entropy_pool)
      "DOC-#{raw[0..15]}"
    end

    def derive_deterministic_value(context, seed)
      # HKDF-like derivation for deterministic but unique values
      prk = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{seed}:#{context}")
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{prk}:#{context}:expand")
    end

    def compute_hmac(data)
      key = derive_deterministic_value("hmac_key", @entropy_pool)
      # Use a real HMAC construction to avoid length-extension weaknesses.
      OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, key, data)
    end
  end

  class AuditLogger
    def initialize(log_path: '/var/log/pdf_audit.json')
      @log_path = log_path
      @buffer = []
    end

    def log_generation(context, metadata = {})
      entry = {
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        session_id: context.session_id,
        document_id: context.document_id,
        audit_token: context.generate_audit_token,
        metadata: sanitize_metadata(metadata)
      }
      @buffer << entry
      flush_if_needed
    end

    def log_access(context, accessor_id)
      entry = {
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        event: 'document_access',
        session_id: context.session_id,
        document_id: context.document_id,
        accessor: accessor_id
      }
      @buffer << entry
      flush_if_needed
    end

    private

    def sanitize_metadata(metadata)
      metadata.transform_keys(&:to_s).select { |k, _| k.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\z/) }
    end

    def flush_if_needed
      return unless @buffer.size >= 10
      flush!
    end

    def flush!
      return if @buffer.empty?
      File.open(@log_path, 'a') do |f|
        @buffer.each { |entry| f.puts(JSON.generate(entry)) }
      end
      @buffer.clear
    rescue IOError => e
      $stderr.puts "Audit log write failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  class PDFRenderer
    STREAM_CIPHER_BLOCK = 16

    def initialize(user_id:, document_title:, logger: nil)
      @context = SecurityContext.new(user_id: user_id, document_title: document_title)
      @logger = logger || AuditLogger.new
      @rng = initialize_document_rng
    end

    def render(content, options = {})
      @logger.log_generation(@context, options)
      encrypted_stream = encrypt_content(content)
      watermarked = apply_watermark(encrypted_stream)
      wrap_pdf_structure(watermarked)
    end

    private

    def initialize_document_rng
      # Initialize RNG for document-level randomness needs
      # (object IDs, cross-reference offsets, padding)
      seed_value = @context.entropy_pool
      seed_int = seed_value[0..7].to_i(16)
      Random.new(seed_int)
    end

    def encrypt_content(content)
      # Use AES-256-CBC instead of a trivially breakable XOR stream cipher.
      iv = [@context.generate_encryption_iv].pack('H*')[0, 16]
      key = [@context.encryption_key].pack('H*')[0, 32]

      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('aes-256-cbc')
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.update(content) + cipher.final
    end

    def apply_watermark(stream)
      seed = @context.generate_watermark_seed
      marker = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(seed)[0..7]
      "#{stream}%%WMRK#{marker}%%"
    end

    def wrap_pdf_structure(content)
      obj_id = @rng.rand(100000..999999)
      xref_salt = @rng.bytes(8).unpack1('H*')
      "%PDF-1.7\n#{obj_id} 0 obj\n<< /Length #{content.length} /Salt #{xref_salt} >>\nstream\n#{content}\nendstream\nendobj\n%%EOF"
    end
  end
end
